critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1328 lines (iter18 adds TaskPatch, due_date on TaskInput, _plan_nudge/_household_goal_nudges helpers, nudge-preview + nudge-goals endpoints). Main agent explicitly deferred the router split — this remains the single highest-priority refactor and has been flagged in iter14/15/16/17/18.

TaskBoard.jsx isOverdue compares `new Date(t.due_date) < new Date(new Date().toDateString())` — toDateString() yields US-locale date string parsed as local midnight, which is correct for same-day guard but subtle. Consider `due_date < today.toISOString().slice(0,10)` string compare for clarity (due_date is YYYY-MM-DD).
TaskBoard.jsx: setDue mutation fires on every date-input change event with no debounce or success toast; multiple quick edits send multiple PATCHes. Low priority UX.

AdvisorClients NudgeModal: `onApply` triggers nudgeMut.mutate(nudge.clientId); the mutation's onSuccess invalidates ['clients'] but NOT ['opps-views']/['tasks']. Opp rows still rely on clients.alerts so this is fine, but task-count badges on the opp row won't refresh if the nudge created an audit entry — currently it doesn't, so acceptable.

nudge-preview and nudge-goals both recompute _household_goal_nudges from scratch — this is correct for idempotency but means if the data mutates between preview GET and apply POST the user's previewed numbers may not match what gets written. Not a bug but worth a note in the UI (e.g. 'computed just now').

MyPlan.jsx welcomeKey uses `user?.id || ''` fallback — if user is briefly null during hydration the key becomes 'compass_welcome_seen_' (shared across users). Add `if (!user) return null;` guard before computing welcomeKey.
_required_monthly uses whole-year math (yr-currentYear)*12; a goal with target_year == currentYear yields months=1 and huge monthly req. Edge case already flagged in iter17 — unresolved.
